title: Grimm's Server
description: Grimm's server is a Spigot/Bukkit plugin, keeping track of player stats and adding an economy to minecraft.
body:
Grimm's server is a Bukkit plugin that adds chat handling, economy features, (NYI) stock market, buying and selling items, factions, admin utilities, etc.


Currently, GMSv1 is only tested for 1.21.1, and GMSv1.1 is only tested for 1.21.4.

This plugin is completely customizable, allowing the disabling of unwanted modules.


### Features:
- Item and Player leveling.
  - These levels are usable to provide buffs and abilities. 
- Economy system
  - A general market to sell and buy items from the sold ones
  - A secondary market to buy unavailable items from
  - Buyable enchantments
- Titles
  - These are similar to achievements
  - Required for certain actions
- Factions
  - Claiming chunks
  - Teaming
- Chat utilities
- /GDim
  - Dimension/World manager
  - Can be used to create and teleport across multiple worlds across the server
- /GUtils
  - Some admin utilities, not fully implemented yet.

This software is provided as is and allowed for use in all servers. 
It is also open source, and contributing is allowed.
